proves.claim: liveFolderRefusal launches no git process for an item whose folder does not exist and answers as git does for no checkout, one elsewhere, a locked one and a spaced path.

cli.item-folder.live-folder-no-launch.why: Without it, a regression where liveFolderRefusal launches no git process for an item whose folder does not exist and answers as git does for no checkout, one elsewhere, a locked one and a spaced path would pass unnoticed.
